description: Shared bit-for-bit constants for HybridBlinkDetector mirrored in ai_pipeline/gaze_intent/gaze_intent.py and core_engine/include/gaze_math.hpp.

policies.missing_blendshapes: When MediaPipe face_blendshapes is None/absent, pack_face emits legacy 484-row payload and HybridBlinkDetector/GazeNative silently falls back to EAR-only hybrid mode (detector_mode='hybrid_ear_only').
policies.invalid_blendshapes: When blendshapes are present but any required channel is missing, non-finite, outside [-1e-4, 1.0 + 1e-4], or native row-486 col-2 sentinel != 1.0 +- 1e-4, the entire face observation is rejected (valid=False, pointer dropped, state=0 Neutral) to match PR #3 all-or-nothing observation integrity.
policies.dsp_recorder_landmark_count: dsp_filter/evaluation/import_vs_trace.py:103 and evaluate_holds.py:161 strictly enforce gaze_landmarks in (-1, 0, 484). main.cpp normalizes 487 -> 484 for DSP trace recording without modifying dsp_filter/; --blink-diag-log exposes the active regime via detector_mode ('hybrid_bs_ear' for 487 vs 'hybrid_ear_only' for 484).

bridge_packing.polarity_proof: Empirically verified on MPIIFaceGaze p00/day01 (0005.jpg, 0030.jpg, 0031.jpg) in BOTH unflipped and cv::flip mirrored frames: MediaPipe FaceMesh LEFT_EYE (33..144) is always image-left (user physical left eye in mirrored webcam frames) and maps to ARKit *Right blendshapes; RIGHT_EYE (362..380) is always image-right (user physical right eye) and maps to ARKit *Left blendshapes.

temporal_smoothing.clock_source: capture_s (monotonic seconds matching DSP/OS), falling back to ts_ms / 1000.0 when capture_s is omitted/negative, and default_dt_seconds when neither is available.
